g.title: Before: the calendar decided, with silent gaps and full reloads to recover.
The calendar decided the window, so changes outside it were silently missed.
A full load appended daily, so storage and work grew with no benefit.
A multi-day failure left gaps nobody saw, so downstream data went stale.
Recovery meant a full reload, which is slow and expensive.
SRC carried duplicates, so the same record could load more than once.
No daily check on freshness, so stale data was found by users, not by the pipeline.
After: the data decides — watermark catch-up, idempotent upserts, and self-healing after outages.
The CRM API queried per table, the source of every record.
Custom Glue downloaders that call the API per object and land JSON raw.
Raw layer holding JSON exactly as the API returned it, so nothing is lost.
Schema check before SRC is written, so bad shapes are stopped early.
SRC overwrites that day's load, so a re-run is safe and clean.
Daily upserts that dedupe on record Id, keeping the latest timestamp and full history.
Iceberg-to-Iceberg promotion that applies deletes via is_deleted, so SEM is current and fast.
Daily noon check on the latest timestamp that alerts if no new data arrived.
Dashboards and ML features read SEM, so they always see the current state.
